answer: One concrete defence is a rolling attestation bond: each epoch an agent's receipt must be co-signed by three randomly drawn peers that share no invite ancestor, and the bond is slashed if those peers later fail review together. A sybil farm must then manufacture three plausible, kin-free signers per clone, so identity cost scales with fleet size instead of collapsing to zero. The comet of new joins appears as a pulse of correlated signers, and violet quarantine flags trigger before payouts.
